comment: Hosts that github.com names in its Content-Security-Policy, or that a signed-out browser requests,
and that this app deliberately does NOT allow. scripts/site-drift.py reads this file: a host that is
neither on the app allow-list (GitHubAllowlist.java) nor listed here is reported as UNREVIEWED and
fails the 'Site drift' workflow, so a new host can never be silently ignored or silently adopted.
'host' is compared with the exact CSP source host (wildcards are written literally, e.g. '*.example.com').
'regex' must match the complete host. Adding an entry here records a refusal; it never widens the app.

exclusions.reason: GitHub analytics beacon. Refused on purpose; pages work without it (see docs/DOMAINS.md).
Microsoft telemetry endpoint. Not needed to render or use github.com.
FullStory session analytics named by the marketing homepage CSP. Not needed to use the site.
GitHub insights/analytics endpoint. Not needed to render or use github.com.
Status site. A separate website; the app shows the native 'Blocked by this app' panel for it.
Gist is a separate site and is intentionally not made browsable or embeddable.
GitHub Copilot APIs. Copilot is intentionally outside this wrapper.
GitHub Copilot proxy. Copilot is intentionally outside this wrapper.
Copilot Workspace form target. Copilot is intentionally outside this wrapper.
Copilot chat attachment storage. Copilot is intentionally outside this wrapper.
Copilot real-time (WebSocket) hosts, one per Azure region. Copilot is intentionally outside this wrapper, so new regions need no change.
Codespaces / VS Code dev tunnels. Intentionally outside this wrapper; wildcards are never copied.
Regional Actions live-log hosts. Not blanket-approved: a wildcard is never copied; a concrete host needs its own reviewed entry.
Wildcard in GitHub's img-src. Never copied; the exact githubusercontent.com hosts the app needs are listed one by one.
Wildcard in GitHub's img-src. Never copied; only lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ (account avatars) is allowed.
Staging real-time channel. Only the production channel alive.github.com is allowed.
Marketplace listing screenshots. Reviewed with the original host inventory and not approved.
Marketing/Explore feed images. Reviewed with the original host inventory and not approved.

Third Contentful media host named by the homepage CSP. The homepage HTML only references images.ctfassets.net and videos.ctfassets.net (both allowed, pinned to GitHub's space); no request to this host has been observed.
Embedded marketing videos on the homepage. No YouTube browsing or playback is granted by this wrapper.
Google sign-in page logging (play.google.com/log). Refused on purpose; the sign-in form renders without it.
Requested by the Android WebView's own autofill service, not by github.com. Refused.
